type: UI schema or registered detail mode
default: registered detail or generated item layout
effect: selects the detail pane for the active row without changing stored data by itself
precedence: the local descriptor is passed to the shared detail resolver before registry/generated fallback; flat config.detail is not used

default: first primitive property of the item schema, then localized Item {index}
effect: reads the displayed row label, using translated enum/oneOf choice labels when available, without modifying data
precedence: local elementLabelProp > first primitive property > localized item number; childLabelProp and flat config.elementLabelProp are ignored

effect: hides only the array summary indicator; row errors remain available and data is unchanged
precedence: local boolean, including false, overrides flat config.hideArraySummaryValidation; showValidationIndicator false also suppresses the summary

effect: when true, disables add/remove at maxItems/minItems bounds without changing current data
precedence: local boolean, including false, overrides flat config.restrict; independent disableAdd/disableRemove and form enabled guards still apply

effect: shows guarded move-up/down actions and reorders array data when activated
precedence: local boolean, including false, overrides flat config.showSortButtons
